result.evidence_quote: This pooled analysis provides compelling evidence supporting the clinical benefit of first-line chemoimmunotherapy in a subset of patients with MSS mCRC. Baseline CD8+ T-cell infiltration may serve as a predictive biomarker for identifying patients most likely to benefit from this treatment approach.
result.rationale: The study directly evaluates clinical cancer treatment outcomes for chemoimmunotherapy in metastatic colorectal cancer and identifies a potential predictive tumor biomarker, matching both the treatment and biomarker interests.
